room_or_space: FIRST (GROUND) FLOOR PLAN - whole ground floor: an unlabelled west end room, BILLIARD ROOM, central masonry core with stair, PLAYROOM, entry hall with stairs, small service rooms, GARAGE, and a walled service yard (east part dotted / labelled CONJECTURAL RESTORATION)

overall_dimensions.length: 161'-6" overall east-west (west end wall to east wall of the service yard), made up of bays 12'-0" + 11'-4" + 20'-2" + 21'-0" + 24'-11" + 54'-7" + 17'-6"
overall_dimensions.width: no overall north-south dimension is given for the main block; the only transverse dimensions are 20'-11" (west end room, north-south) and 46'-6" (service yard along its east wall, north-south)

proportions.notable_proportion: Extremely elongated bar plan: 161'-6" overall length against a 20'-11" room depth at the west end. Along the south range the BILLIARD ROOM (31'-9") and PLAYROOM (22'-9") flank a central 8'-6" masonry core, with near-equal end passages of 6'-0" (west) and 6'-4" (east); the garage wing alone (54'-7" + 17'-6") is longer than the two main rooms together.

layout.organisation: Linear east-west plan in two parallel strips. The south strip is an enfilade: west end room with a chevron-shaped (pointed) wall projection and a freestanding square pier, then a 6'-0" passage, the BILLIARD ROOM, the thick hatched central core (chimney/stair mass, 8'-6" wide), the PLAYROOM, and a 6'-4" passage to an east stair. The north strip holds a row of windows and a long hall/terrace edge with an unlabelled fine-gridded rectangle, the entry hall with stairs, and two small service rooms with closet-like partitions. East of the main block the GARAGE (three bays) and a walled service yard run on, the eastern addition drawn in dotted lines and the yard wall marked CONJECTURAL RESTORATION.
layout.axes: One dominant long east-west axis through the billiard room, core and playroom; a secondary north-south cross-axis through the central core and entry hall where the UP stairs are placed. The west end room is set on the long axis and terminated by the pointed projection.
layout.entry_sequence: A recessed doorway in the north wall at the entry hall (within the 24'-11" bay) leads into a small hall; from the hall a stair rises UP against the central core and doorways open west to the billiard room and east to the playroom and service rooms. Secondary stairs marked DOWN leave from the hall, from the south-west corner of the west end room and from the south-east end of the playroom; a stair marked UP enters the west end room at its north-west.
layout.circulation: Movement is along the long axis, passing the central core on both its north and south sides through swing-door openings. The south walls of billiard room and playroom are lined with french doors to the south yard (which the note says are now closed off). The garage opens south through three double-door bays into the service yard; the dotted addition and the service rooms connect to the yard by single doors. Dashed lines inside the billiard room and playroom show temporary partitions subdividing them.
